definitions: The process of creating or simulating energy spectra using the SIMNRA software, typically for Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS) or other ion beam analysis techniques.
The output or result of a simulation performed with SIMNRA software to model the energy distribution of detected particles after interaction with a sample.
examples: SIMNRA spectrum generation is crucial for accurate material characterization.
The research team relied on SIMNRA spectrum generation to interpret their experimental data.
Optimizing SIMNRA spectrum generation parameters improved the fit to the measured spectrum.
